narrative:
## Handover Summary — Operating Cost Plan

The cost plan is approved at business unit and cost line level, with AI-identified savings shown separately from the base plan.

## Key Decisions
• Head office overheads reduced through PMIS process simplification
• Technology & data reduced as legacy platform licences exit
• Shop occupancy reduced on energy hedge roll-off and lease regears

## Recommendation for Estate & Investment Phase
Check that refurbishment depreciation and technology modernisation phasing are consistent with these savings dates.

signals.title: Meter Programme — 5 legacy data platforms into Snowflake
signals.excerpt: Consolidating BigQuery, Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL estates onto Snowflake. Oracle Finance (CDC), Kooper and DIDOS already landed but under-used by Finance.

signals.title: National Living Wage uplift confirmed
signals.excerpt: Statutory pay floor rises above most retailer budget assumptions, adding pressure to Partner pay as the largest single cost line.
